author: Stahly
description:
A few months ago, I received prototypes of Gaahleri's Omnishift paints, which are currently running as a campaign on Kickstarter. Back then, I still had some reservations. Now, Gaahleri has sent me the Omni Primary 10-Color Set to test. Can the finalized product win me over?

The post Gaahleri Omni Series review: great for airbrushing, tricky with a brush appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Gaahleri Omni Series review: great for airbrushing, tricky with a brush
